description: This file provides type declarations for the 'punycode' module which is a bundled version of the Punycode.js library used in Node.js. It includes function signatures for encoding, decoding, and converting domain names between Unicode and ASCII, along with relevant deprecation notices.

methods.name: function decode(string: string): string; decode
methods.description: Converts a Punycode ASCII string into Unicode string.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Converts a Unicode string into a Punycode ASCII string.

methods.name: toUnicode
methods.description: Converts a domain name with Punycode segments into Unicode.

methods.name: toASCII
methods.description: Converts Unicode domain name into its ASCII Punycode representation.
